extension.description: Multi-engine translation for developers: editor selections, documents, terminal output, official APIs, AI and local models.
command.explainTerminalSelection: AI Translate and Explain Terminal Selection
config.uiLanguage.description: PolyLingo runtime interface language. Auto follows the current VS Code display language. Native VS Code context-menu labels follow VS Code's display language.
config.title: PolyLingo Settings
config.provider.description: Translation provider. “Auto” falls back through the configured provider order.
config.provider.auto: Try enabled providers in the configured order
config.provider.googleFree: Unofficial keyless Google web endpoint; may change without notice
config.provider.bingWeb: Experimental Bing web translator adapter; may change without notice
config.provider.mymemory: MyMemory public API; source auto uses local language guessing
config.provider.libreTranslate: LibreTranslate server; self-hosted instances can be free
config.provider.deepl: Official DeepL API; user API key required
config.provider.azure: Official Azure Translator API; key and region required
config.provider.googleCloud: Google Cloud Translation v2; API key required
config.provider.baidu: Baidu Translate API; app id and secret required
config.provider.tencent: Tencent Cloud TMT; SecretId and SecretKey required
config.targetLanguage.description: Target language code. Default: Simplified Chinese (zh-CN).
config.proxy.enabled.description: Enable the default proxy policy. Individual translation engines can override this setting.
config.proxy.description: Default HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL. When enabled and empty, inherit VS Code http.proxy, HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY environment variables, then the operating system proxy.
config.maxSelectionChars.description: Maximum characters translated in one selection command.
config.document.mode.smart: Translate Markdown/plain text while protecting code fences; source-code documents translate comments only
config.document.mode.whole: Translate the entire document as text
config.selection.autoTranslate.descripti: Automatically translate in the selection hover. When disabled, the hover shows a Translate button instead.
config.selection.debounceMs.description: Delay before showing the selection hover or starting automatic translation.
config.result.showOutputChannel.descript: Legacy compatibility setting. Output remains available from result actions.
config.googleFree.endpoint.description: Google free web endpoint. This is not the official paid Cloud Translation API.
config.bingWeb.endpoint.description: Bing Translator web page used to obtain the experimental web translation token.
config.mymemory.email.description: Optional contact email sent to MyMemory as the “de” parameter for higher anonymous limits according to their API policy.
config.deepl.baseUrl.description: DeepL API base URL. Use https://api.deepl.com/v2 for Pro.
config.azure.region.description: Azure Translator region. API key is stored separately in SecretStorage.
config.openAI.model.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible provider.
config.openAI.extraHeaders.description: Optional additional HTTP headers for OpenAI-compatible services. Do not put secrets here.
config.providerEnabled.description: Enable this translation engine. In the PolyLingo dynamic Settings panel, engine-specific options are shown only after the engine is enabled.
config.ai.prompt.description: Built-in AI translation prompt shared by OpenAI Compatible and Ollama. Supports {task}, {targetLanguage}, {sourceLanguage}, and {context} placeholders.
config.result.editorPresentation.descrip: Where editor selection translation results are displayed.
config.result.terminalPresentation.descr: Where terminal translation results are displayed.
